design: INDIVIDUAL 15: a stocky older female councillor, broad shoulders and athletic calves, light ochre hide heavily mottled black, slightly arched rear cranium and short thick tendrils fanning down the back. Structured violet sleeveless tabard with big ivory side panels, large square bronze medallion and a low belt with three carved wooden plaques. One hand cups an old spherical council token, the other reaches gently toward an unseen interlocutor. Upright engaged silhouette.
